page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Top: the heading "INDEX SECTIONUM" with one item (3) and its continuation line. Then the heading "SECT. III. CAP. IV." with a numbered list of items 1 to 10. Then "SECTIO QUARTA" and "CAPUT PRIMUM" with a numbered list of items 1 to 7. At the lower right, the catchword "SECT.". No margins with text, no page number, no running head.

main_text.l: 3. Quandoque Stylus curiæ spectat litis deciso-ria.

page.notes: The initial "D" of item 1 is a large woodcut letter joined to "E voce" as "DE voce". The catchword "SECT." is set at the lower right of the page. The text at the top right of the scan has ink specks, not printed text. Long s is printed as a plain s throughout.
